title: Grok config.toml (user / project / managed / system tiers)
description: Schema for ~/.grok/config.toml, project .grok/config.toml, ~/.grok/managed_config.toml, and /etc/grok/managed_config.toml — all tiers share this shape and are layered. Layer precedence quoted from ConfigLayers::effective_config_base: the merge starts from system_managed, then deep-merges managed, then user, then user_requirements, then system_requirements, then mdm_requirements — i.e. system_managed < managed < user < user_requirements < system_requirements < mdm_requirements, later layers overriding earlier ones on leaf conflicts. The real deserialization root is agent::config::Config (49 serde-visible fields), deep-merged onto Config::default() before deserializing, so no top-level key is required. Additional legal top-level keys never present on that struct: [folder_trust] and [dashboard] (read ad-hoc off the raw TOML), [[campaigns]] and [[version_overrides]] (patch arrays stripped before layer merge), and [model.*]/[auth_provider.*]/[model_providers.*] (bespoke tolerant parsers, stripped before struct deserialize). $VAR/${VAR} references are expanded in every string value when a file layer is loaded; the macOS MDM tier is decoded from base64 (ai.x.grok:requirements_toml_base64) without passing through that loader, so no env expansion applies there. No struct uses deny_unknown_fields — unknown keys are tolerated (warned) everywhere, so this schema never sets additionalProperties:false.

enabled.description: Workflows feature toggle; unset defers to remote/default.

doom_loop_recovery.description: [doom_loop_recovery] — ONE shared struct serves this TOML table and the remote settings doom_loop_recovery object; all fields Option so a partial object never fails. Per-field precedence env > TOML > remote > default.

enabled.description: Send the doom-loop-check header and parse reported triggers; false is a kill-switch, absent = client default (off).

max_threshold.description: Highest tail_repetition threshold considered confident; clamped to 2..=64 by the resolver (any u32 parses). Absent = client default 8.

max_retries.description: Resample budget per turn; clamped to 0..=5 by the resolver (any u32 parses). Absent = client default 2.

auto_mode.description: [auto_mode] — server-side configuration for Auto permission mode; ONE struct serves the TOML table and the remote auto_mode object. Precedence: local config > remote > built-in defaults.

enabled.description: Auto-mode gate (env and local config win over the remote value).

prompt_type.description: How much context the classifier prompt includes (workspace ClassifierPromptType; typed enum — an unrecognized value fails the parse). Unset = built-in default "just_command".

classifier_model.description: Routing slug for a dedicated classifier model; unset inherits the session model.

classify_timeout_ms.description: Classifier side-query budget in milliseconds; unset = 30000. Any u64 parses, then auto_mode_classify_timeout clamps the effective value into 1000..=120000 with a warning.

reasoning_effort.description: Classifier reasoning effort (ReasoningEffort; typed — an unrecognized value fails the parse). Unset = built-in default (low if the effective model supports it).

auth.description: [auth] — accepted alias table for [grok_com_config], merged onto it pre-parse by expand_auth_alias; existing grok_com_config keys win on conflict.

shortcuts.description: [shortcuts] — opaque passthrough (Option<toml::Value>); any TOML value is accepted.

hints.description: [hints] — opaque; written by the client via config_toml_edit and absorbed so it is not flagged as unrecognized. Any TOML value is accepted.

shell_environment_policy.description: [shell_environment_policy] — which environment variables agent subprocesses (bash tool, terminals) inherit; enforced at the shell spawn sites on macOS, Linux, and Windows. The Config field of this name is a known-keys scan struct only (every key Option<toml::Value>, no deny_unknown_fields), so a misspelled key is just an unrecognized-key warning; the authoritative parse is resolve_shell_env_policy at spawn, and if the table fails to deserialize there the whole policy is dropped with a warning and the child inherits the full environment. Applied in order: start from inherit; if ignore_default_excludes is false drop the built-in secret patterns *KEY*/*SECRET*/*TOKEN*; drop exclude; insert set; if include_only is non-empty keep only those. Absent section = full inheritance.

inherit.description: Base environment: "all" (default, every variable) | "core" (platform basics only — PATH, HOME, SHELL, ...) | "none". NOT an enum here: ShellEnvironmentPolicyInherit is typed, but an unrecognized value only fails the spawn-time parse, which warns and falls back to inheriting the full environment instead of failing the config load.

ignore_default_excludes.description: Skip the built-in secret excludes; true (the default) keeps *KEY*/*SECRET*/*TOKEN* variables, false drops them.

exclude.description: Case-insensitive variable-name globs (* and ?) dropped from the inherited environment.

set.description: Literal variables inserted into the base environment before include_only filtering (an unmatched name is then dropped); request env layered at spawn can still override them.

include_only.description: Case-insensitive variable-name globs (* and ?); when non-empty only matching names survive. Empty (the default) admits everything.

auto_compact_threshold_percent.description: Context-window usage percentage (documented 0-100; serde accepts any u8) triggering auto-compact; unset falls through remote tiers to the hardcoded default 85.

load_envrc.description: Load environment variables from .envrc into bash commands; defaults to true when unset.

agent.description: [agent] — agent definition selection for all sessions (unless overridden by CLI flag or ACP meta).

name.description: Name of a built-in or discovered agent definition (e.g. "grok-build", "browser-use").

definition.description: Path to an agent definition file (.md with YAML frontmatter); supports env-var expansion.

system_prompt_label.description: Global system-prompt identity label; per-model override wins.

enabled.description: Enable change-archive dedup.

include_inline_fallback.description: Include inline content even when references exist.

max_inline_bytes.description: Omit inline content larger than this (0 = no limit).

untracked_max_bytes.description: Skip untracked files larger than this (0 = no limit).

untracked_exclude_globs.description: Glob patterns to exclude untracked paths.

paths.description: Additional skill locations (SKILL.md file or directory walked recursively; ~ expansion).

ignore.description: Path prefixes to exclude; matching skills are filtered out entirely (~ expansion).

disabled.description: Skill names disabled but still listed (excluded from system prompt and invocation).

bundled_skill_dirs.description: Launcher-injected platform bundled skill dirs (Bundled scope).

compat.description: [compat] — per-vendor x per-surface compatibility toggles; each cell None resolves to true.

paths.description: Additional plugin directory paths to load.

disabled.description: Plugin IDs or names to disable (discovered but components not loaded).

enabled.description: Plugin IDs or names to explicitly enable (overrides the project-scope disabled-by-default rule).

feedback.description: [feedback] — feedback submission configuration; trusted config tiers only for the command escape hatch.

user.description: Self-reported feedback author identity (never used for authorization).

name.description: Sources tried in order for the name; "os_user" yields the OS user name, anything else is a literal ($VAR expanded at load).

email.description: Sources tried in order for the email; "git_email" yields the global git email, anything else a literal needing @.

email_domain.description: Fallback domain for <name>@<domain> when no email source resolves.

command.description: Optional sh -c script printing {"name","email"} JSON; per-field fallback; trusted config tiers only.

paths.description: [paths] — extra directories to scan for skills and rules (written by /import-claude).

cli.description: [cli] — CLI launcher settings (deserialized from TOML, never written back by the shell).

auto_update.description: Auto-update toggle; /settings "auto_update" persists here (effective default true, restart required).

dismissed_version.description: Version whose update prompt was dismissed.

show_tips.description: Tip-of-the-day on startup; Some(false) suppresses (also read ad-hoc by show_tips_from_toml_opt).

session_registry.description: Session registry toggle; resolution config > remote > false.

minimum_version.description: Soft update floor (env GROK_MINIMUM_VERSION); folded semver-max across layers plus env, so managed floors can't be lowered. Only steers the updater — a target below it is skipped as a downgrade; it never blocks startup.

maximum_version.description: Soft update ceiling (env GROK_MAXIMUM_VERSION); folded semver-min across layers plus env, so a bound can only be tightened. Clamps the update target down; it never blocks startup. Unrelated to version_overrides[].maximum_version, which gates config patches.

required_minimum_version.description: Hard organization floor (env GROK_REQUIRED_MINIMUM_VERSION); folded semver-max. Refuses to start when the running version is below it, rejects an explicit `grok update --version` pin below it, and clamps the update target up. A required range contradicting itself (min > max) falls back to the managed-only bounds, then fails open.

required_maximum_version.description: Hard organization ceiling (env GROK_REQUIRED_MAXIMUM_VERSION); folded semver-min. Refuses to start when the running version is above it and clamps the update target down; a pin above it is still allowed so a too-new install can recover. Fails open on a contradictory required range.

session_picker_grouped.description: Group sessions by repo in the picker and CLI listings.

block_for_upload.description: Block turn end for the upload flush.

upload_flush_timeout_secs.description: Budget (seconds) for the turn-end upload flush when block_for_upload is active; default 60.

relay.description: [relay] — relay session sharing; GROK_RELAY_SYNC_ENABLED env wins over config; unset = false. Same shape as config-types RelaySyncConfig.

enabled.description: Enable relay sync.

hub.description: [hub] — optional default Computer Hub URL for workspace provider exposure; does not enable agent-side connections.

url.description: Hub WebSocket URL (ws:// or wss://) used as the leader default for `grok workspace start`.

worktree_pool.description: [worktree_pool] — pre-created worktree pool. TWO shapes exist for this key: the root Config field uses the all-Option WorktreePoolConfig modeled here (this is the strict parse that gates config load); a second, differently-shaped xai_grok_config_types::PoolConfig (per-field defaults enabled=true, pool_size=2, file_count_threshold=50000, parallelism=3) is parsed tolerantly from the same key by worktree_pool_from_toml (falls back to full defaults on error). Those PoolConfig defaults are the effective resolver defaults for unset fields.

enabled.description: Whether the pool is enabled; effective default true.

pool_size.description: Number of worktrees kept ready; effective default 2.

file_count_threshold.description: Minimum tracked files for the pool to activate; effective default 50000.

parallelism.description: Threads used for worktree creation when populating the pool; effective default 3.

sandbox.description: [sandbox] section. Profile resolution: requirement > CLI > GROK_SANDBOX env > config > "off".

profile.description: "off", "workspace", "devbox", "read-only", "strict", or a custom profile name (any string parses).

auto_allow_bash.description: Skip bash permission prompts when the sandbox is active; default false.

mcp_servers.description: [mcp_servers.<name>] — MCP server definitions keyed by server name.

disabled_mcp_tools.description: Per-server lists of disabled tool names.

subagents.description: [subagents] — subagent (task tool) support. Enabled by default; disabled only via GROK_SUBAGENTS=0 or an explicit `enabled = false` (SubagentsConfig::resolve gates on the raw key, so the derived serde default of false for the plain bool is not the effective default).

enabled.description: Whether subagent support is enabled; effective default true (see section description).

models.description: [subagents.models] — per-subagent model ID overrides (agent name -> model ID).

toggle.description: [subagents.toggle] — per-subagent enable/disable; omitted agents default to enabled.

additionalProperties.description: Declarative subagent role (xai_grok_subagent_resolution SubagentRole): known keys include description, default_capability_mode (read-only|read-write|execute|all), model, prompt_file; external type not fully expanded here.
Named persona (xai_grok_subagent_resolution SubagentPersona): known keys include instructions and instructions_file; external type not fully expanded here.

compaction.description: [compaction] — pre-compaction memory flush and tool-result pruning (compaction behaviors, deliberately NOT under [memory]).

managed_mcps.description: [managed_mcps] — managed MCP connector fetching. Priority: env > TOML > remote > default (enabled interactive, disabled headless).

enabled.description: Fetch managed MCP configs from the managed connectors service at startup.

desktop.description: [desktop] — owned by grok-desktop (Electron app), opaque to the CLI agent; any TOML value is accepted.

announcements.description: Top-level announcements array, consumed by resolve_announcements.

tips.description: [tips] — local tip overrides, consumed by merge_tips.

exclude_default.description: When true, drop remote/default tips entirely.

tools.description: [tools] — cross-cutting tool behavior; also read field-wise by ToolsConfig::resolve so a malformed sub-table cannot wipe sibling flags.

respect_gitignore.description: When true, all tools (including read_file) filter gitignored files.

disable_zdr_incompatible_tools.description: Drop tools whose xAI API requires server-side artifact storage (currently video_gen); intended for ZDR-bound teams via managed_config.toml.

zdr_video_output_s3.description: [tools.zdr_video_output_s3] — S3 bucket config for ZDR video output (ZdrVideoOutputS3Config, external type not expanded here); only effective when disable_zdr_incompatible_tools is true.

storage.description: [storage] — session persistence settings, read by resolve_cleanup_ttl_days.

cleanup_ttl_days.description: Days to keep stale sessions before cleanup; resolver default 30.

suggestions.description: [suggestions] — shell command suggestion pipeline (history, path, AI).

enabled.description: Enable suggestions; resolution GROK_SUGGESTIONS env > config > remote > false.

ai_enabled.description: Enable AI suggestions; resolution GROK_SUGGESTIONS_AI env > config > remote > false.

marketplace.description: [marketplace] — plugin marketplace sources; also read by xai_grok_plugin_marketplace::load_sources.

official_marketplace_auto_installed.description: Opaque bookkeeping written out-of-band by extensions::marketplace; any TOML value accepted (typed Option<toml::Value> so a wrong type can't fail load).

default_skills_installs_purged.description: Opaque bookkeeping written out-of-band by extensions::marketplace; any TOML value accepted.

default_auto_mode.description: Start sessions in auto permission mode (classifier) when no per-session override.

disable_web_search.description: Force-disable the web search tool regardless of available credentials.

path_not_found_hints.description: Enrich path-not-found errors with CWD reminders and similar-name suggestions; default false, enabled via remote settings.

folder_trust.description: [folder_trust] — read ad-hoc off the raw TOML by the workspace crate (never a Config field). Precedence on release builds: GROK_FOLDER_TRUST env > user config > managed > remote folder_trust_enabled > default true; local/dev builds always auto-trust and ignore this key.

enabled.description: Folder-trust gate toggle, read via folder_trust.enabled as_bool (non-bool values are ignored, not errors).

dashboard.description: [dashboard] — persisted dashboard state. Lives in pager-crate code but persists to ~/.grok/config.toml (config_path() = grok_home()/config.toml), NOT pager.toml. Parsed leniently via toml_edit: malformed individual fields silently fall back to defaults and can never fail the load, so no value here is a hard constraint. Written atomically via <path>.dashboard.tmp.<pid> + rename, refusing to touch a present-but-unparseable file.

enabled.description: Dashboard toggle (boolean); non-bool values fall back to the default true.

grouping.description: Row grouping: "state" (default) or "directory" (alias "dir"); unrecognized or non-string values fall back to "state".

pinned.description: Array of persist-key strings for pinned rows (capped at 256 entries / 1024 chars each); malformed values fall back to empty.

reorder.description: Array of persist-key strings recording manual row order; malformed values fall back to empty.

id.description: Campaign identifier; entries with a missing/blank id are skipped with a warning.

items.description: One [[campaigns]] entry: an optional id plus an ARBITRARY config patch (every non-meta key is overlay payload deep-merged onto the effective config), so no closed value schema is possible.

campaigns.description: [[campaigns]] — patch array consumed and STRIPPED before the effective config reaches agent::config::Config (never a Config field). Priority (first id wins): requirements > remote > user > managed > system_managed. A meta-deserialize failure drops all entries with a warning (tolerant).

minimum_version.description: Semver lower bound (inclusive); missing = 0.0.0. An invalid semver string is a HARD load error.

maximum_version.description: Semver upper bound (inclusive); optional. An invalid semver string is a HARD load error.

items.description: One [[version_overrides]] entry: optional semver bounds plus an ARBITRARY config patch deep-merged when the installed version matches.

version_overrides.description: [[version_overrides]] — semver-gated patch array, always stripped before the struct parse regardless of match; matching patches are deep-merged in ascending minimum_version order (stable sort; ties keep declared order so later entries win).

model.description: [model.<id>] — per-model overrides parsed by a bespoke tolerant parser (parse_model_overrides collects warnings instead of failing) and STRIPPED from the table before the struct deserialize.

additionalProperties.description: One [auth_provider.<name>] credential-helper table (crate::auth::AuthProviderConfig, parsed tolerantly by parse_auth_providers from trusted config layers only; type not expanded here).

auth_provider.description: [auth_provider.<name>] — external auth provider definitions, parsed by parse_auth_providers and STRIPPED before the struct deserialize.

additionalProperties.description: One [model_providers.<id>] table (ModelProviderConfig, parsed tolerantly by parse_model_providers; known keys include auth (inline auth provider) and auth_provider (name reference); type not expanded here).

model_providers.description: [model_providers.<id>] — model provider definitions, parsed by parse_model_providers and STRIPPED before the struct deserialize.

support_permission.description: When set, the agent may ask permission for tool executions.

telemetry.description: TelemetryMode: true/false (legacy bool) or a string — recognized strings: "1"/"true"/"yes"/"on"/"enabled"/"full" (Enabled), "0"/"false"/"no"/"off"/"disabled" (Disabled), "session-metrics"/"session_metrics" (SessionMetrics). Unrecognized strings are tolerated and treated as disabled with a warning; non-bool/non-string values FAIL the parse. Unset defers to remote/default (off).

codebase_indexing.description: Codebase graph indexing: true | false | ["glob", "!negative-glob", ...]. Default true (index any git repo).

non_git_warning.description: Blocking warning when starting outside a Git repository; a present remote flag takes precedence.

feedback.description: Feedback system (heuristic popups + /feedback); unset defers to remote/default (true).

managed_config.description: Managed config fetching (managed_config.toml + requirements.toml); unset defers to env/default (true).

lsp_tools.description: LSP tools toggle; unset defers to remote/env/default (false).

tool_search.description: MCP tool search/discovery; unset defers to remote/env/default (true).

web_fetch.description: Web fetch tool; unset defers to remote/env/default (false).

ask_user_question.description: Ask-user-question tool; unset defers to remote/env/default (true).

session_recap.description: Session recap (/recap + automatic return-from-away recap); unset defers to remote/env/default (true).

voice_mode.description: Voice dictation (STT); unset = env/remote/default on; set false in requirements/managed to force off.

two_pass_compaction.description: Two-pass (prefire) compaction; unset defers to remote/env/default (false).

image_gen.description: Image generation tool (image_gen / /imagine); unset defers to GROK_IMAGE_GEN/remote/default (true). A requirements pin wins outright, and a remote imagine-tool disable forces it off.

video_gen.description: Video generation tool; unset defers to remote/env/default (true); a remote imagine-tool disable forces it off.

image_gen_model_override.description: image_gen Imagine model override; unset/empty defers to remote/env/default (grok-imagine-image-quality).

image_edit_model_override.description: image_edit Imagine model override; unset/empty defers to GROK_IMAGE_EDIT_MODEL_OVERRIDE then remote settings, else the tool's own edit model.

write_file.description: Write file tool; unset defers to remote/env/default (true).

cancel_rewind.description: Cancel-rewind (Ctrl+C before first activity restores the prompt); unset defers to remote/env/default (true).

auto_wake.description: Auto-wake: inject a synthetic prompt when a background task/subagent completes; unset defers to remote/env/default (true).

backend_tools.description: Backend-executed tools (web_search, x_search server-side); unset defers to env/default (true).

compaction_mode.description: "summary" (default) | "transcript" | "segments"; unset defers to CLI/env; parsed via CompactionMode::parse (any string parses at the serde layer).

compaction_detail.description: "none" | "minimal" | "balanced" | "verbose" (default); unset defers to env; any string parses at the serde layer.

compaction_verbatim_input.description: Feed the summarizer the verbatim conversation instead of the lossy rewrite; unset defers to env/remote/default (true).

subagent_worktree_snapshot.description: Snapshot a completed subagent's isolated worktree into a durable git ref (per-deployment rollout lever, managed_config.toml [features]); unset defers to remote/default (false).

mcp_liveness_watchers.description: Per-Ready-client transport-liveness pollers + session-actor StatusDispatcher; unset defers to env/default (true).

mcp_auto_restart.description: Bounded stdio MCP auto-restart (up to 3 respawns with backoff); unset defers to env/default (on).

mcp_push_server_status.description: Pager subscription to the server_status push; NOTE the pager-side gate is env-only (GROK_MCP_PUSH_SERVER_STATUS) and does NOT read this field.

mcp_recursive_config_watch.description: Whether the leader's ConfigFileWatcher adds the two narrow non-recursive cwd watches (documented misnomer — gates existence, not recursion); unset defers to env/default (true).

goal.description: [goal] — canonical /goal configuration; keys mirror the remote goal_* keys with the prefix dropped. Per-key precedence env > this config > remote > default.

enabled.description: Goal system toggle.

use_current_model_only.description: Restrict goal roles to the current session model.

strategist_every.description: Run the strategist every N turns.

planner_model.description: Planner role model — intended shape {model: string, agent_type: string} (GoalRoleModel), but the deserializer is TOLERANT: a malformed value is dropped to unset with a warning, never a parse failure, so any value is accepted.

strategist_model.description: Strategist role model — same tolerant GoalRoleModel semantics as planner_model.

skeptic_models.description: Array of tolerant GoalRoleModel entries; malformed entries are dropped, a non-array value yields an empty list — never a parse failure.

worktreeAutoGc.description: [worktree.auto_gc] — auto-GC policy; ONE struct for local TOML and remote worktree_auto_gc. Field-wise TOLERANT deserialize: a wrong-typed field becomes unset instead of failing, so no value here can fail the load (fields are typed permissively on purpose).

enabled.description: Boolean intended; false is a kill-switch, absent = default on. Wrong types tolerated to unset.

max_age_secs.description: Integer seconds intended; age cutoff when platform age-expiry is allowed, clamped by the resolver (resolver default 7 days). Wrong types tolerated to unset.

min_interval_secs.description: Integer seconds intended; min interval between successful auto-GC stamps (resolver default 6 hours). Wrong types tolerated to unset.

dry_run.description: Boolean intended; count age candidates without deleting. Wrong types tolerated to unset.

include_orphan_snapshots.description: Boolean intended; Linux only. Wrong types tolerated to unset.

max_age_by_kind.description: Map of kind (session/ab/pool/fork/manual/subagent) to seconds (integer), "never", or null; unknown kinds ignored at resolve; wrong types tolerated to unset.

include_rebuild.description: Boolean intended; optional discovery rebuild + stale .git/worktrees prune (default off). Wrong types tolerated to unset.

rebuild_min_interval_secs.description: Integer seconds intended; independent rebuild throttle, absent = 24h. Wrong types tolerated to unset.

grokComConfig.description: [grok_com_config] — grok.com/auth configuration (also reachable via the [auth] alias).

grok_ws_origin.description: WebSocket origin; struct-Default provided when omitted (GROK_WS_ORIGIN env overrides the compiled production value).

grok_ws_url.description: WebSocket URL; struct-Default provided when omitted (GROK_WS_URL env overrides the compiled production value).

token_header.description: Auth token header name; struct-Default provided when omitted.

oidc.description: [grok_com_config.oidc] — customer OIDC IdP configuration; issuer and client_id are serde-required.

scopes.description: Requested scopes; defaults to the built-in OIDC scope set when omitted.

oauth2.description: [grok_com_config.oauth2] — OAuth2 provider config (Auth Code + PKCE); preferred over the legacy relay flow when set. issuer and client_id are serde-required.

scopes.description: Requested scopes; defaults to the built-in OAuth2 scope set when omitted.

referrer.description: Client-supplied referrer for OAuth usage-attribution analytics.

auth_provider_command.description: External auth provider command (stdout = token, stderr = user UX, exit 0 = success).

auth_token_ttl.description: Token TTL seconds for external providers that output bare tokens without expires_in.

disable_api_key_auth.description: Admin kill switch: api-key auth neither advertised nor accepted.

force_login_team_uuid.description: Restrict login to a specific team: single string or array of allowed teams; an EMPTY array fails closed. Untagged — both shapes valid.

preferred_method.description: Pin automatic auth to one method; when set and unavailable, auth fails (no fallthrough). Typed enum — other strings fail the parse.

ui.description: [ui] section (UiConfig; the pager settings modal persists most of its entries here).

max_thoughts_width.description: Max width for thought rendering (settings modal bounds 40-500; serde accepts any u16).

fork_secondary_model.description: Model ID for the secondary agent when forking; defaults to the main default model.

ui_theme.description: UI theme alias; read by util::config.

compact_mode.description: Compact mode; read by the pager.

simple_mode.description: Simple mode; read by the pager (unset is treated as true).

permission_mode.description: Permission mode (settings choices: default/ask/auto/always-approve); read by load_permission_mode.

approval_mode.description: Legacy alias name for permission_mode (separate key, both accepted).

default_selected_permission.description: Which permission option the cursor preselects on the FIRST permission prompt (allow_once | allow_always | reject; unset preselects always-allow-all-sessions).

show_timestamps.description: Show timestamps; written by the pager's appearance persist module (effective default true).

show_timeline.description: Timeline sidebar (per-turn tick rail in place of the scrollbar); unset = off (opt-in).

page_flip_on_send.description: Snap a just-sent prompt to the viewport top; unset = on.

auto_dark_theme.description: Theme used when the OS is in dark mode (effective default groknight).

auto_light_theme.description: Theme used when the OS is in light mode (effective default grokday).

scroll_speed.description: Mouse-wheel and trackpad scroll speed multiplier (documented 1-100; serde accepts any u8; settings default 50).

scroll_mode.description: Force scroll input classification: auto | wheel | trackpad (any string parses; unset = auto).

scroll_lines.description: Lines per scroll tick for wheel and trackpad (documented 1-10; serde accepts any u8; settings default 3).

render_mermaid.description: How mermaid code blocks are rendered: auto | on | off (any string parses; unset = auto).

hunk_tracker_mode.description: Hunk-tracker mode advertised to the agent: agent_only | all_dirty | off (any string parses; settings default agent_only; CLI/env override).

voice_capture_mode.description: Voice capture chord behavior: toggle | hold (any string parses; unset = hold).

voice_stt_language.description: STT language preference: a Grok STT catalog code (en, es, ja, ...) or "auto"; unset leaves [voice].language / default en.

voice_keybind_enabled.description: Whether the Ctrl+Space / F8 voice-dictation chord is active; written by the settings modal, unset = true. When false the chord is ignored — /voice still starts dictation.

mouse_reporting_toggle.description: Register Ctrl+R (scrollback focused) to toggle terminal mouse reporting; opt-in only.

cancel_subagents_on_turn_cancel.description: When cancelling a parent turn with running subagents: always_stop | always_continue; unset shows the cancel-turn picker.

remember_tool_approvals.description: Show granular per-tool "Always allow" options on permission prompts; requirements/env/managed/remote also feed the effective gate.

keep_text_selection.description: In-app drag selection highlight: "flash" | "hold" (also "word_select"); legacy bool accepted — true maps to "hold", false to "flash".

selection_highlight_duration_ms.description: Legacy TTL ms; only 0 counts (as hold) when keep_text_selection is unset.

show_thinking_blocks.description: Show agent thinking/reasoning blocks in the TUI scrollback; unset = on.

group_tool_verbs.description: Fold runs of consecutive non-destructive tool calls into one transcript row; unset = on.

collapsed_edit_blocks.description: Show Edit tool calls as a collapsed one-line +N/-M diffstat summary by default; unset = off.

prompt_suggestions.description: Next-prompt suggestions (tab autocomplete ghost text) after each turn; unset = on; GROK_PROMPT_SUGGESTIONS env overrides.

cursor_blink.description: Startup cursor style: unset inherits the terminal's own style, true = blinking block, false = steady block. Config-file-only knob.

double_click_action.description: Retired opt-in for double/triple-click word/line selection; superseded by keep_text_selection = "word_select"; read only when keep_text_selection is unset.

contextual_hints.description: [ui.contextual_hints] — per-tip opt-outs; each unset inherits remote/default (on).

undo.description: Undo tip (Ctrl+Z after a substantial draft wipe).

send_now.description: Send-now tip after queuing a mid-turn follow-up.

combine_queued_prompts.description: Combine consecutive queued follow-ups into one turn; unset = off.

display_refresh.description: [ui.display_refresh] — display-refresh probe + auto-cadence; field-wise TOLERANT deserialize (wrong types become unset, never a failure) and a flatten catch-all preserves unknown keys, so fields are typed permissively on purpose. Client defaults: probe on, auto off, floor 8 ms, ceiling 16 ms, Hz band 55-165.

probe_enabled.description: Boolean intended; once-per-process primary-display Hz probe, false is a kill-switch. Wrong types tolerated to unset.

auto_cadence_enabled.description: Boolean intended; derive paint/scroll cadence from a successful probe (default off). Wrong types tolerated to unset.

floor_ms.description: Integer intended; lower clamp for auto-derived ms (default 8). Wrong types tolerated to unset.

ceiling_ms.description: Integer intended; upper clamp for auto-derived ms (default 16). Wrong types tolerated to unset.

min_hz.description: Integer intended; minimum accepted probe Hz (default 55). Wrong types tolerated to unset.

max_hz.description: Integer intended; maximum accepted probe Hz (default 165). Wrong types tolerated to unset.

max_timeout_secs.description: Foreground ceiling for model-provided timeouts (seconds); unset = production default 36000 (10h); bounds foreground only.

cmd_prefix.description: Command prefix prepended to every bash invocation.

auto_background_on_timeout.description: Auto-background a command when it times out (effective default true).

foreground_block_budget_ms.description: Max FG block before auto-bg (ms); unset = server default 15s; 0 = no short budget.

allow_background_operator.description: Allow a background & operator in foreground commands (resolution config > remote > true).

web_search.description: [toolset.web_search] — SamplerConfig from the external xai_grok_sampler crate (typed struct; not expanded in this schema — includes api_key, base_url, model, sampling parameters).

proxy_endpoint.description: Egress proxy endpoint; resolution TOML > GROK_WEB_FETCH_PROXY env > remote > none.

allowed_domains.description: Domains the tool may fetch; overrides the built-in allowlist; an explicit empty list blocks all fetches.

allow_local.description: Allow fetches to explicit loopback hosts only; private/metadata ranges stay blocked; default off.

ask_user_question.description: [toolset.ask_user_question] — questionnaire timeout settings, consumed out-of-band so precedence (requirements > env > user > managed > remote) holds.

timeout_enabled.description: Whether the questionnaire timeout is armed (default true); false waits forever.

timeout_secs.description: Wait budget in seconds when armed (default 1800 / 30 minutes).

file_toolset.description: Which file-operation toolset to use; typed enum (snake_case) — other strings fail the parse.

hashline.description: [toolset.hashline] — hashline anchor scheme parameters; only used when file_toolset = "hashline". Values are validated at use (validate()), not at parse.

scheme.description: "chunk" (default) or "content_only"; any string parses, validate() rejects others at use.

hash_len.description: Anchor hash length in characters; validate() requires 1..=4.

chunk_size.description: Chunk size for the chunk scheme; validate() requires > 0.

endpoints.description: [endpoints] — URL/header overrides mapping ~1:1 to GROK_*/OTEL_* env vars (env wins).

cli_chat_proxy_base_url.description: cli-chat-proxy base URL; unset (or blank) lets resolvers apply the compiled default.

xai_api_base_url.description: Base URL for the public xAI API (struct-defaulted when omitted; GROK_XAI_API_BASE_URL env overrides).

alpha_test_key.description: Optional extra access-header value (non-production feature, first-party hosts only).

models_base_url.description: Env GROK_MODELS_BASE_URL; enables custom endpoint mode; list URL defaults to {base}/models.

models_list_url.description: Env GROK_MODELS_LIST_URL; overrides the {base}/models list URL. Alias: models_endpoint.

models_endpoint.description: Accepted serde alias spelling for models_list_url.

feedback_base_url.description: Env GROK_FEEDBACK_BASE_URL; where feedback submissions go.

trace_upload_url.description: Env GROK_TRACE_UPLOAD_URL; where trace uploads go.

trace_upload_bucket.description: Env GROK_TRACE_UPLOAD_BUCKET; direct bucket (gs:// or s3://), bypasses proxy.

trace_upload_credentials_file.description: Env GROK_TRACE_UPLOAD_CREDENTIALS_FILE; path to GCS SA key or AWS credentials file.

trace_upload_credentials.description: Inline credentials (JSON/INI); takes precedence over credentials_file.

deployment_key.description: Env GROK_DEPLOYMENT_KEY; management API key for enterprise deployments.

managed_config_url.description: Env GROK_MANAGED_CONFIG_URL; managed config endpoint override (defaults to {proxy_url}/deployment/config).

otel_exporter_otlp_endpoint.description: Env OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT; OTLP collector base (/v1/traces appended); legacy internal-pipeline repoint.

otel_exporter_otlp_traces_endpoint.description: Env OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT; full traces endpoint used verbatim; overrides otel_exporter_otlp_endpoint.

otel_exporter_otlp_headers.description: Env OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS; k=v,k2=v2 merged onto export headers.

grok_internal_otlp_traces_endpoint.description: Env GROK_INTERNAL_OTLP_TRACES_ENDPOINT; full INTERNAL traces endpoint (dev/debug); wins over legacy OTEL_* vars.

grok_internal_otlp_headers.description: Env GROK_INTERNAL_OTLP_HEADERS; extra headers for the internal export.

otel_traces_exporter.description: Env OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER; "otlp" (default) or "none" to disable spans (only the exact string "none" disables; anything else keeps export on).

otel_traces_export_interval.description: Env OTEL_BSP_SCHEDULE_DELAY / OTEL_TRACES_EXPORT_INTERVAL; batch flush interval (ms).

asset_server_url.description: Asset server base URL (profile images, etc.); env GROK_ASSET_SERVER_URL; struct-defaulted when omitted.

telemetry.description: [telemetry] — telemetry-engine configuration; the on/off toggle itself lives at [features] telemetry.

enabled.description: Declared for unrecognized-key scanning only; the actual toggle is [features] telemetry.

events_url.description: Telemetry events endpoint (baked build-time default when omitted).

events_api_key.description: Telemetry events API key (baked build-time default when omitted).

mixpanel_token.description: Mixpanel token (baked build-time default when omitted).

mixpanel_enabled.description: Mixpanel toggle; struct default derives from the build-time token.

trace_upload.description: Unset inherits from [features] telemetry; false disables GCS uploads only.

otel_enabled.description: External OTEL master switch (= GROK_EXTERNAL_OTEL; env wins).

otel_metrics_exporter.description: External OTEL metrics exporter: otlp | console | none (any string parses).

otel_logs_exporter.description: External OTEL logs/events exporter: otlp | console | none (any string parses).

otel_endpoint.description: External OTLP base endpoint (/v1/logs, /v1/metrics appended for HTTP).

otel_protocol.description: External OTLP transport: http/protobuf | grpc. Alias: otel_transport.

otel_transport.description: Accepted serde alias spelling for otel_protocol.

otel_log_user_prompts.description: External OTEL content gate; admins can pin to false via requirements.

otel_log_tool_details.description: External OTEL content gate; admins can pin to false via requirements.

default_reasoning_effort.description: Persisted reasoning effort for the default model (ReasoningEffort; typed — an unrecognized value fails the parse).

image_description.description: Vision model used to transcribe user-supplied images.

prompt_suggestion.description: Model pin for next-prompt suggestions; unset = remote pin then built-in default with catalog guard.

allowed_models.description: Glob patterns (* ? [...]) restricting which models are user-selectable; empty = no restriction; an excluded explicit default/-m is rejected at startup.

hidden_models.description: Force hidden = true on these model IDs (still usable via -m).

disabled_models.description: Remove these model IDs from the catalog entirely; wins over hidden_models.

agent_type.description: Fallback agent_type for models without a per-model override.

extra_headers.description: Global default request headers applied to every model; per-model [model.<id>].extra_headers overrides per key (case-insensitive).

temperature.description: Global default temperature for models leaving it unset; per-model value wins.

top_p.description: Global default top_p; per-model value wins.

max_completion_tokens.description: Global default max completion tokens; per-model value wins.

max_retries.description: Global default max retries; per-model value wins.

inference_idle_timeout_secs.description: Global default inference idle timeout; per-model value wins.

stream_tool_calls.description: Global default for streaming tool calls; per-model value wins.

vendorCompat.description: Per-vendor compat surface toggles; each unset cell resolves to true.

mcpServer.description: One [mcp_servers.<name>] entry (McpServerConfig): a flattened untagged transport plus server-level options. Transport selection: an object whose `command` parses as a string deserializes as Stdio; anything else deserializes as StreamableHttp because `url` carries #[serde(default)] — so an entry with NEITHER command NOR url is VALID (url = "", and to_acp_mcp_server later drops empty-url servers), an entry with BOTH command and url is VALID (untagged picks Stdio first; url is an ignored unknown field), and even a wrong-typed `command` is VALID (Stdio fails, StreamableHttp ignores the unknown key). anyOf (not oneOf) is used deliberately to mirror those untagged first-match semantics.

command.description: Stdio transport: executable to spawn (the variant discriminator).

cwd.description: Working directory (standard MCP JSON supports cwd; ACP stdio config does not yet expose it).

url.description: HTTP/SSE endpoint URL; carries #[serde(default)] so it may be omitted (empty-url servers are dropped at ACP conversion, not at parse). Aliases: urlTemplate, url_template.

urlTemplate.description: Accepted serde alias spelling for url.

url_template.description: Accepted serde alias spelling for url.

type.description: Transport type hint; "sse" (case-insensitive) or a url ending in /sse selects SSE, anything else is streamable HTTP.

bearer_token_env_var.description: Env var read and sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

oauth_client_id.description: OAuth client ID for providers without Dynamic Client Registration.

oauth_client_secret_env_var.description: Env var holding the OAuth client secret (BYO credentials).

anyOf.description: StreamableHttp transport variant (no required properties — url defaults to "").

enabled.description: Whether the server is enabled.

oauth.description: OAuth block; keys are camelCase on the wire.

clientSecretEnvVar.description: Env var holding the client secret.

setup.description: Interactive-setup schema (v0 supports exactly one select field).

from.description: Field id this variable derives from.

map.description: Option value to substituted value map.

additionalProperties.description: A derived setup variable substituted into {{...}} templates.

values.description: Accepted serde alias spelling for variables.

tool_timeouts.description: Per-tool timeout overrides in seconds; falls back to tool_timeout_sec for unlisted tools.

expose_image_base64.description: Also keep raw base64 in tool-result text (~2x tokens per image); overridden by _meta.mcpConfig.<server>.exposeImageBase64.

memory.description: [memory] — memory system configuration; disabled by default, enabled via --experimental-memory / GROK_MEMORY=1. Flush and pruning live under [compaction], not here.

enabled.description: Whether memory is enabled for this session.

max_chunk_chars.description: Maximum chunk size in characters (approx tokens x 4).

model.description: Embedding model name; unset disables vector embeddings.

vector_weight.description: Weight for vector similarity in hybrid scoring.

text_weight.description: Weight for BM25 text similarity in hybrid scoring.

recency_decay.description: DEPRECATED — use temporal_decay; per-day decay factor (0.0-1.0), converted to an approximate half-life for backward compatibility.

temporal_decay.description: Temporal decay for time-aware scoring; only session chunks decay (exponential half-life).

enabled.description: Whether temporal decay is enabled.

half_life_days.description: Days after which a session chunk's score is halved; non-positive disables decay at resolve.

enabled.description: Whether MMR re-ranking is enabled.

lambda.description: Relevance/diversity trade-off; values outside [0,1] are CLAMPED at parse time (never rejected).

source_weights.description: Source-type weight multipliers; all default to 1.0.

enabled.description: Search memory and inject a reminder on the first turn.

min_score.description: Optional score threshold override; unset uses the historical default 0.0.

save_on_end.description: Auto-save a session summary to memory on session end.

watcher.description: [memory.watcher] — file watcher for external memory edits.

enabled.description: Whether the file watcher is enabled (when memory is enabled).

stale_claim_secs.description: Seconds after which a reindex claim is considered stale (crashed agent).

gc.description: [memory.gc] — GC for orphaned workspace memory directories.

max_age_days.description: Age after which session-file-less workspaces are removed.

enabled.description: Whether autoDream consolidation is enabled.

min_sessions.description: Minimum sessions since last consolidation to trigger.

stale_lock_secs.description: Seconds before a stale dream lock is reclaimed.

check_interval_secs.description: Periodic dream check interval in seconds; unset = disabled (dream only at session end or via /dream).

enabled.description: Whether the flush step runs before compaction.

soft_threshold_tokens.description: Token headroom before the compact threshold to trigger flush.

flush_model.description: Model for the flush turn; unset = session's primary model.

max_flush_write_chars.description: Max characters the flush response may write to memory.

idle_timeout_secs.description: Idle seconds before a background flush triggers; unset = disabled.

semantic_dedup_threshold.description: Cosine similarity threshold for semantic dedup; unset = compiled-in default 0.92; values outside [0,1] are CLAMPED at parse, never rejected.

enabled.description: Whether pruning is enabled.

keep_last_n_turns.description: Recent turns whose tool results are never pruned.

soft_trim_threshold.description: Character threshold above which old tool results are soft-trimmed.

soft_trim_head.description: Characters kept from the start of a soft-trimmed result.

soft_trim_tail.description: Characters kept from the end of a soft-trimmed result.

hard_clear_age_turns.description: Turn age after which tool results are hard-cleared (placeholder).

permission.description: [permission] — permission policy. Parsed OUT-OF-BAND from the raw table (the Config field only absorbs known keys); project .grok/config.toml [permission] overrides global wholesale, no deep merge. TWO shapes are accepted: the compact form (deny/allow/ask arrays of rule strings, tried first) and the verbose [[permission.rules]] form (used only when no compact key is present).

allow.description: Compact form: rule strings with action=allow (e.g. "Bash(git *)", "WebFetch(domain:example.com)"); non-string entries are warned and skipped.

deny.description: Compact form: rule strings with action=deny.

ask.description: Compact form: rule strings with action=ask.

action.description: Action when the rule matches; serde-REQUIRED (the Default of deny exists per CWE-1188 but the field carries no serde default). Typed enum — other strings fail the PermissionConfig parse.

pattern_mode.description: Pattern interpretation: glob, or domain (match URL host, from WebFetch(domain:...)). Typed enum.

rules.description: Verbose [[permission.rules]] form; ignored when any compact key (allow/deny/ask) is present.

configModelOverride.description: One [model.<id>] override (ConfigModelOverride). Parsed by the bespoke tolerant parser (warnings, not hard failures).

api_key.description: Static API key; wins over auth_provider when both are set.

env_key.description: Env var name(s) for the provider key — string or array.

auth_provider.description: Name of an [auth_provider.<name>] credential helper minting this model's bearer token.

model_provider.description: Name of a [model_providers.<id>] entry supplying provider defaults.

api_backend.description: API backend (ApiBackend enum, snake_case; struct default chat_completions). NOT an enum here: the bespoke [model.<id>] parser prunes an unrecognized value with a warning instead of failing the load.

extra_headers.description: Per-model request headers; override global [models].extra_headers per key.

query_params.description: Query parameters folded (percent-encoded) into every request URL for this model; merged into ModelInfo only when non-empty, so it cannot override an inherited [model_providers.<id>].query_params back to empty. A non-string value prunes the whole key with a warning rather than failing the load.

env_http_headers.description: Header name -> environment variable name; only the mapping is persisted, never the resolved secret. Merged into ModelInfo only when non-empty, so it cannot override an inherited [model_providers.<id>].env_http_headers back to empty. A non-string value prunes the whole key with a warning rather than failing the load.

auto_compact_threshold_percent.description: Per-model auto-compact threshold override (documented 0-100; serde accepts any u8).

hidden.description: Hide from the picker (still usable via -m).

supported_in_api.description: Whether the model is supported in the API.

reasoning_effort.description: Default reasoning effort (ReasoningEffort, lowercase). NOT an enum here: the bespoke [model.<id>] parser prunes an unrecognized value with a warning instead of failing the load.

supports_reasoning_effort.description: Whether the model supports reasoning effort.

reasoning_efforts.description: Available reasoning effort options (ReasoningEffortOption; not expanded here).

supports_backend_search.description: Whether the model supports backend search.

compactions_remaining.description: CompactionsRemaining value (shape not expanded here). Alias: send_compactions_remaining — a table containing BOTH spellings is rejected by the alias-aware parser.
